desc_en: Hailuo vs Runway tested side by side in 2026: video quality, character motion, editing tools, pricing, and which AI video generator wins for your workflow.
desc_zh: 2026 年 Hailuo 与 Runway 并排实测：视频质量、角色动作、剪辑工具、价格，以及哪款 AI 视频生成器更适合你的工作流。

faq.q_en: Hailuo vs Runway: which is better in 2026?
faq.a_en: For character motion and coherent shots, Hailuo (MiniMax) wins at low cost. For a production editing pipeline (green screen, frame interpolation, Gen-3 generation), Runway is the more complete toolkit. Most creators we tested end up using Runway for editing and Hailuo for motion-heavy clips.
faq.q_zh: Hailuo vs Runway：2026 年哪个更好？
faq.a_zh: 角色动作与连贯镜头上，Hailuo（MiniMax）以低成本胜出；需要绿幕、帧插值、Gen-3 生成等完整剪辑管线时，Runway 是更完整的工具包。我们测试的大多数创作者用 Runway 剪辑、用 Hailuo 生成动作密集片段。

faq.q_en: Is Hailuo better than Runway for text-to-video?
faq.a_en: For short social clips with lively character animation, Hailuo's output is more coherent per dollar. Runway Gen-3 leads on scene composition and editing integration. There is no single winner - it depends whether you need raw generation or a full editing suite.
faq.q_zh: 文生视频上 Hailuo 比 Runway 更好吗？
faq.a_zh: 对角色动画生动的短视频，Hailuo 每美元产出更连贯；Runway Gen-3 在场景构图与剪辑集成上领先。没有单一赢家——取决于你需要纯生成还是完整剪辑套件。

faq.q_en: Can I use Hailuo and Runway together?
faq.a_en: Yes. A common workflow: generate motion-heavy clips in Hailuo, then bring them into Runway for green-screen, upscaling, and frame interpolation. Both have free tiers, so testing the combo costs nothing.
faq.q_zh: 可以同时使用 Hailuo 和 Runway 吗？
faq.a_zh: 可以。常见工作流：在 Hailuo 生成动作密集片段，再导入 Runway 做绿幕、放大与帧插值。两者都有免费版，组合测试零成本。

faq.q_en: Which is cheaper: Hailuo or Runway?
faq.a_en: Hailuo's free tier and credit pricing make it the cheaper option for casual generation. Runway's Standard/Pro plans bundle editing features, which is better value if you also need video editing.
faq.q_zh: Hailuo 和 Runway 哪个更便宜？
faq.a_zh: Hailuo 的免费版和积分定价让它在轻度生成上更便宜；Runway 的 Standard/Pro 套餐捆绑剪辑功能，如果你同时需要视频剪辑则更划算。

desc_en: GitHub Copilot vs Replit tested in 2026: IDE-native AI coding, multi-file edits, agent workflows, and which setup fits your dev environment.
desc_zh: 2026 年 GitHub Copilot 与 Replit 实测：IDE 原生 AI 编程、多文件编辑、Agent 工作流，以及哪种开发环境更适合你。

faq.q_en: GitHub Copilot vs Replit: which is better for developers in 2026?
faq.a_en: If you already live in VS Code or JetBrains, GitHub Copilot is the lower-friction choice with deep IDE integration. If you want a zero-setup browser environment that can also deploy, Replit wins. For professional teams on existing repos, Copilot; for prototypes and students, Replit.
faq.q_zh: GitHub Copilot vs Replit：2026 年开发者该选哪个？
faq.a_zh: 如果你已经使用 VS Code 或 JetBrains，GitHub Copilot 集成更深、上手成本更低；想要零配置、可部署的浏览器环境则 Replit 胜出。既有仓库的专业团队选 Copilot，原型与学习场景选 Replit。

faq.q_en: Can GitHub Copilot and Replit be used together?
faq.a_en: Yes. Some developers prototype fast in Replit, then move production code into their main IDE with Copilot assisting. The two serve different stages of the same workflow.
faq.q_zh: 可以同时使用 GitHub Copilot 和 Replit 吗？
faq.a_zh: 可以。一些开发者先在 Replit 快速原型，再把生产代码移回主力 IDE 由 Copilot 辅助。两者服务于同一工作流的不同阶段。

faq.q_en: Is GitHub Copilot better than Replit for coding?
faq.a_en: Copilot is stronger for whole-function completion and multi-file edits inside a real IDE. Replit's AI agent handles entire build-this-app prompts and one-click deploy, which is better for beginners and quick experiments.
faq.q_zh: 编码能力上 GitHub Copilot 比 Replit 更好吗？
faq.a_zh: Copilot 在真实 IDE 内的整函数补全与多文件编辑上更强；Replit 的 AI Agent 能处理「帮我构建这个应用」式完整需求并一键部署，更适合初学者和快速实验。

faq.q_en: GitHub Copilot vs Replit pricing in 2026?
faq.a_en: GitHub Copilot Pro is about $10/month (with free tiers for students and open-source maintainers), while Replit offers a free tier and Core plan with advanced AI. Both are affordable; choose by environment, not price.
faq.q_zh: 2026 年 GitHub Copilot 与 Replit 价格如何？
faq.a_zh: GitHub Copilot Pro 约 $10/月（学生与开源维护者有免费版）；Replit 提供免费版与含高级 AI 的 Core 套餐。两者都可负担——按环境而非价格选择。
